propositions: The packaged code-review guide (src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md, lines 112–114) contains stale documentation that incorrectly instructs contributors to ping a maintainer when a coverage-gap block occurs.

The self-service recheck-review mechanism was shipped in production (Gerrit change 1243) and documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/review-policy.md, but the packaged guide was not updated, making it the most discoverable surface that actively misdirects contributors.
The coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name recheck-review as the contributor self-service re-trigger and explain that recheck (CI) and recheck-review (LLM review) mirror each other.
Validation requires make lint (format/whitespace) and verification that rebar explain review renders the updated text correctly in the worktree.
